title: DeepCirc-Interp: Data Files and Code
description: Source-panel correction release for the DeepCirc interpretability companion. Includes denominator-normalized binary-presence enrichment data and code for Figure S10 and Table S3, scientifically corrected Figure S11 source-panel labels and rendering, portable complete preview builds, and focused validation tests. Figure S11 attribution estimates and archived simulation inputs are unchanged. The release provides source panels and review previews; final Illustrator composition and manuscript, Methods, and figure/table legend revisions are deferred. Historical legend files in the source archive are preserved for provenance and are not current descriptions of this correction.
notes: Correction release derived from V-SCode/DeepCircMI commit 0556a8bb137b03f67951cdca93d0161aed4565f4. Continues the manual Zenodo version series under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20576708 (previous version record 23227964). No new model or attribution simulations. Private full-data directories and stale Illustrator masters are excluded from the correction bundle. See docs/source_revision_v1.1.1.md and docs/zenodo_release.md for scope and provenance.
